description: This file defines a service class 'SlotsWorkerService_2024_04_15' that manages a pool of worker threads to process slot scheduling tasks asynchronously. It includes methods for initializing, handling worker failures, serializing request context, and queuing tasks for worker execution.

classes.name: SlotsWorkerService_2024_04_15
classes.description: A NestJS injectable service that manages a pool of worker threads for processing slot schedule computations asynchronously, with robust failure handling and task queuing.

methods.name: initializeWorkerPool
methods.description: Creates and initializes the worker pool with a fixed number of worker threads.

methods.name: createNewWorker
methods.description: Creates a new worker thread, sets up persistent error and exit handlers, and adds it to the pool.

methods.name: handleWorkerFailure
methods.description: Handles worker thread failures by removing the failed worker, terminating it, and replacing it with a new worker.

methods.name: getSerializableContext
methods.description: Serializes the request context (cookies and headers) for communication with worker threads.

methods.name: processNextTask
methods.description: Assigns queued tasks to available workers and sets up one-time message and error listeners for task completion.

methods.name: getAvailableSlotsInWorker
methods.description: Public method to enqueue a slot scheduling task to be processed by the worker pool, returning a promise.

methods.name: onModuleDestroy
methods.description: Gracefully terminates all worker threads when the service is destroyed.
